title: The Short Man and the Lift
summary: Find the assumption you added yourself and drop it.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: A man lives on the 20th floor. Every morning he takes the lift all the way down.
On the way home he takes the lift to the 10th floor and walks the rest, except on rainy days when he goes straight to 20.
points: A man lives on the 20th floor. Every morning he takes the lift all the way down.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Ask what could be true about the man, not about the building.
Look at what changes on rainy days.
points: Ask what could be true about the man, not about the building.

steps.title: The method: Question your assumptions
sentences: What do we assume? We assume he can reach every button.
What does the rainy day change? He carries an umbrella.
Maybe he can reach only the lower buttons.
points: What do we assume? We assume he can reach every button.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: He is too short to reach the button for the 20th floor, but on rainy days he uses his umbrella to press it.
The clue was the rainy day.
Lateral thinking means dropping an assumption that is not in the puzzle.
points: He is too short to reach the button for the 20th floor, but on rainy days he uses his umbrella to press it.
